description: ABDMS2000 DSP Parameter Conversion Summary - Schema-driven migration v1
migrationStatus: Complete - All DSP conversion formulas now use conversion::normalizedToDomain()

nonMigratedParameterGroups.note: All envelope parameters (env1Attack, env1Decay, env1Sustain, env1Release, env2Attack, env2Decay, env2Sustain, env2Release) currently use inline formulas in SynthEngine::applySeqModulation() and Voice.cpp. These may be migrated in future phases. New schema parameters added: env1Sustain, env1Release, env2Attack, env2Decay.

Oscillator and LFO depth parameters (osc1Pitch, osc1Waveform, osc2Pitch, lfo1Amount, lfo2Amount, filterKbdTrack) may have hardcoded formulas pending full schema definition and conversion function migration.

generationTools.name: ParameterMeta struct
generationTools.description: Extended with 8 new fields (wire, wireCodec, curve, curveP0, curveP1, domainMin, domainMax, smoothing) - 20 total fields

keyBenefits: Single source of truth for all parameter wire-type and physical-domain conversions
Curve types (Linear/Exp/Pow) and domain ranges (domainMin/domainMax) defined per-parameter in JSON
Wire CC/None/Bipolar types supported via wireCodec field
All DSP receives normalized [0,1] values; schema defines physical domain conversion
Incremental migration: Voice.cpp (1 change) + SynthEngine.cpp (3 changes) = 4/4 critical formulas migrated
Schema now includes 277 parameters covering filters, envelopes, LFOs, oscillators, and FX parameters
